description: This file contains unit tests for decoding health status JSON data in the OpenClaw project. It defines test cases for functionality such as decoding clean JSON, JSON with extraneous noise, and invalid data.

classes.name: HealthDecodeTests
classes.description: A struct containing unit tests for health snapshot JSON decoding functions.

methods.name: `decodes clean JSON`
methods.description: Tests decoding of a minimal, correctly formatted JSON string.

methods.name: `decodes with leading noise`
methods.description: Tests decoding JSON that has extraneous log noise preceding the JSON data.

methods.name: `fails without braces`
methods.description: Tests decoding behavior with invalid (non-JSON) input data.
